notes.title: Become a Hero on XBox One and PS4
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11552132/187e6f070d4e61c6e527353d2a61ef4536a32aa3.png

Dear fellow HEROES,
 
Today we have heroic news for you. 

We recently slowed down on regular updates. This is because we’ve been working full-time on bringing HERO DEFENSE to Xbox One and Playstation 4. 

We are getting closer to the console release, and can honestly say that the experience playing on a big screen with controller is quite outstanding.

We’re delighted to announce that we’ve reached an agreement with our friends at Headup Games to move the development of HERO DEFENSE to this new direction.

Most importantly, Headup Games strongly believe in our HERO DEFENSE vision in our conversations since our first Greenlight announcement. Their support and experience has helped to realize HERO DEFENSE’s console development. 

Due to our new partnership and the console release plans, we are temporarily disabling new Steam purchases during the transition period.

What does this mean for HERO DEFENSE on Steam? Well, here’s the plan:

Relaunch on Steam in 2017 with the Xbox One and PS4 release
Attract an expanded audience with the new Steam edition
If you already have HD on Steam, you will also get Continued support and updates. 
Multiplayer will be removed for the new version. We haven’t sustained a large enough player-base to offer a strong multiplayer experience
Multiplayer may be re-introduced at a later stage if the new edition attracts enough players


For further inquiries, please reach out to our friends at Headup Games via herodefense@headupgames.com.

As always, it’s important for Happy Tuesday to be close to you, our community – on the forums, Facebook, Twitter and wherever you want to touch base with us.

We hope you’re looking forward to HERO DEFENSE’s console release and Steam re-launch as much as us, and we thank you for joining us on this heroic journey.

Keep hunting,
Happy Tuesday & Headup Games

notes.title: Sam’s Pumpkin Soup
notes.content:
http://happy-tuesday.de/HauntedIsland/img/sams_soup.jpg

Happy Tuesday!

It’s that time of year when we start wrapping up warm with scarves and hats, playing tricks on our friends and making… pumpkin soup.

To get you in the mood for a #HauntedHalloween, Sam Hain shares her top secret Pumpkin Soup recipe with us. Featuring a blend of Cinnamon and Nutmeg, this simple soup will put a smile on your face and may even help you to defeat Count Necrosis.

Now, stand back or burn with the corpses!

Ingredients

    Pumpkin
    Onion
    Carrot
    3 Cloves Garlic
    1 Spoon Cinnamon
    1 Spoon Nutmeg
    1 liter hot vegetable stock
    Olive Oil
http://happy-tuesday.de/HauntedIsland/img/divider2.png
Instructions
[olist]
    Preheat the oven to 180°C
    Cut the pumpkin in half, remove seeds and chop into wedges
    Place on a large baking tray and drizzle over a bit of olive oil
    Sprinkle cinnamon, nutmeg and salt over the pumpkin
    Roast the pumpkin for 1 hour until slightly caramelized 
    Roughly chop the onion, garlic and carrot
    Heat some olive oil over a medium heat in a large saucepan
    Add the vegetables and cook for 15 minutes until soft and sweet
    When the pumpkin is ready, add to the pan with hot stock & water
    Blend or use a stick blender until you reach your desired consistency
[/olist]

notes.title: Update: Lava Falls
notes.content:
http://www.happy-tuesday.com/HauntedIsland/img/lavafalls_header2.png

Nestled in the Haunted Island’s steep mountain range, lurk the fabled Lava Falls. Cascading rivers of magma swiftly descend at extremely high altitude. 

Do you have the guts and stamina to withstand the heat, and beat the creeps? 

Happy Tuesday showcased Lava Falls to an enthusiastic crowd at the gamescom. Now it’s time to bring the lava home and melt some corpses, together.

http://www.happy-tuesday.com/HauntedIsland/img/lavafalls_photo6thumb.png      http://www.happy-tuesday.com/HauntedIsland/img/lavafalls_photo2thumb.png

Unlike other maps, Lava Falls is asymmetrical, forcing you and your friends to experiment with a variety of gameplay styles. More challenging than previous experiences, it features a warm blend of summer colors and is our toughest Co-op map yet.

Enjoy playing Lava Falls and the array of improvements coming your way, today. Playing with the Steam Controller is easier and more fun, and you can now cycle through your Heroes with Tab or Caps Lock.

Wishing you all a scorching end to the summer!
/Happy Tuesday

P.S. As always, you can find the Patch Notes in the usual place.

notes.title: Update 1.0.1 & Co-op
notes.content:
HAPPY TUESDAY! Many of you will be very happy to hear that we are currently working on a Co-op mode for Hero Defense, except something on this front soon! 
For now - here's a teaser on the new Co-op map:
http://happy-tuesday.com/HauntedIsland/img/Skullriver_Small.gif

We are also releasing Patch 1.0.1 today, bringing in some changes. 

IMPORTANT NOTICE - Due to a server issue, players from germany might have trouble downloading the newest patch, changing the "Download Region" of Steam to the U.S will fix this

Pure skill competitive multi player
We are changing the way a multi player season works - from now on, you will start with an already big pool of runes and skill points, but will not get any more with more matches. 
This means that you will no longer be pummelled by players who just played more than you did, it all comes down to your skill, rune builds and heroes. 
Creeps on multi player maps will still drop gold - this can be used to buy spells directly on the map. 

Additionally, we are introducing the Hall of Fame - with each season you participated in, you receive Fame, increasing your rank on this leader board. 

Cheater general amnesty
With the new pure skill system, we are doing a general amnesty for every cheater that has been banned so far. If these individuals (you know who you are) are detected again as cheaters, it will result in a life-long ban from Hero Defense. 

Zoom
Use the mouse wheel to zoom to get a better overview of the map and see everything! 

Bugfixes
We also did a bunch of bugfixes - we've fixed the tooltips being offset, some issues in the intro sequence, and we also added the missing translations of Italian and Portuguese

As always, you can find the full Release notes HERE

notes.title: FULL RELEASE!
notes.content:
http://happy-tuesday.com/HauntedIsland/img/Release.png

IT'S A VERY HAPPY TUESDAY!
Hero Defense is now out of the Early Access program and officially released.
Again we want to say thanks to our community - thank you for your time, your feedback and your love!

Even if you already know how the game works, the new tutorial is definitely worth checking out. 

Improved Multiplayer GUI
We've added the "OPPONENT VIEWER" to the multiplayer mode, perfectly showing you your enemies' weaknesses to exploit. 
Additionally, we've added better feedback to show why you won or lost a game. 

More Features!
There's a ton of small stuff being added to the game as well - more music, more languages, multiplayer achievements, more endless mode maps, etc, etc. 

And because that is not enough, we've been very busy with obliterating every bug we could find on the island. For a complete list, see our PATCH NOTES.

notes.title: Action Tower Defense goes next level!
notes.content:
http://www.happy-tuesday.com/HauntedIsland/img/Action_TD.png

Haunted Island is an unique action packed take on the Tower Defense genre.

In order to destroy the powerful Count and his flesh-eating armies, your team of slayers must combine their forces to impale, slash, tear and burn through legions of undead creeps.

I especially love games within the genre that attempt to be innovative, tell a story and those that possess a high presentation level with a lot of charm. All three do a good job of summarizing Happy Tuesday’s fantastic Steam debut in Hero Defense: Haunted Island.

I personally really enjoy the mobility and quick (but measured) pace that having movable hero units gives you.


From the misty cemetery, to the dark mines, many a road you will have to travel and compete against evil forces located on multiple maps across the haunted island. 

A new chapter in the history of Tower Defense is being written. Join us on this epic adventure!

notes.title: 2 Month of Early Access - What happened?
notes.content:
http://happy-tuesday.com/HauntedIsland/img/2MonthsEA.jpg

As all of you know - we've been in Early Access for 2 Month now! 
Only thanks to you, our strong community, we’ve been able to focus on improving the game more and more. 
We improved the game and added features. All based on your feedback every week. We want to share all we have achieved together so far. 

Endless Mode
With the last patch we’ve released the first version of the Endless mode, which will be improved in the next patches. You’ll be able to play Endless challenges on a lot of different maps and brag about it to your friends! 

Hero Balancing! 
As the game is called Hero Defense, it of course is very important for us that the Heroes are properly balanced – to this end we’ve implemented some additional features
We’ve completely revamped the way how different bonuses stack, making shrines and auras much more powerful in the Endgame. 
We looked (and are still looking) at the usefulness of every skill and improve it where necessary. 
We improved the Creep affinity of heroes like Barrows and Jane to make them fill out their roles better. 

 http://happy-tuesday.com/HauntedIsland/img/RuneMerge.jpg

Rune Merge!
Everybody loves the Rune System – it provides a lot of flexibility and customization and let’s you play the game how you want to play it. 
That is why we came up with Rune Merging for you – Lesser runes can be merged together to gain higher level runes – giving you a steady progress and improvement upon your rune set. 

 http://happy-tuesday.com/HauntedIsland/img/UserExperience.jpg

Improved Tutorial and first User Experience!
We've watched a lot of people play and listened to what you wanted, so we've improved some of the Tutorials and added some more where necessary. 
We also did a major balancing pass on the play through of the campaign to give you a nice and smooth experience. 
Tutorials were added to showcase the building of Shrines
We’ve balanced the last few levels to make going through them smoother and remove unnecessary difficulty bumps. 
The ability to skip Tutorials was added to allow for a quicker entrance into the game. 

Tooltips!
To better explain all the various bells and whistles of the game, we've implemented a tooltip system, that shows you additional information about pretty much everything. 
So far, we’ve included Tooltips for
Ingame Runes
For Currencies and Resources
Skills
Spells

Improved Controls
Especially at the start of EA we implemented lots of fixes and improvements to make controlling the heroes much smoother.  
Fixed lots of issues with unresponsive clicks. 
Added hotkeys for every action in the game and an option menu to configure them
Added border and arrow scrolling for the camera. 

Map Balancing
Through lots and lots of community feedback we've been able to fix major exploits and very much improve the balance of the Heroes and enemies. 
We’ve vastly improved upon the “gold farming exploit” that allowed to farm hundreds of thousands of gold pieces in a short amount of time
We already did several passes on Skill and Hero Balancing, to bring them all into an enjoyable range.  
There were fixed and improvements in the later map balancing, they were brought into a nice range of difficulty
Removed unnecessary Difficulty Gates
Reduced overall need to grind a lot throughout the campaign. 


 http://happy-tuesday.com/HauntedIsland/img/SteamFeatures.jpg

Steam Features!
A whole bunch of steam features were activated: 
32 Achievements
10 Trading cards
Cloud Saves to enable playing on different computers. 

Additional Languages! 
To allow more of you to play the game in their native language, we’re continuously expanding the available languages in the game – during the EA we’ve added quite a few supported languages: 
Russian
Portuguese
French

 Save slots
If you want to experience all of the changes in the game and the balancing and economy improvements, you can start up a new game without losing your progress! 

 http://happy-tuesday.com/HauntedIsland/img/ClosedMultiplayer.jpg

Closed Multiplayer Tests
In the development of the multiplayer we've moved forward with a good pace - we already had the first successful tests with some community members and will continue to so.  
Tough we did hit a few bumps on the way, that is why we cannot open the Multiplayer just yet - after all we want to give you the best possible Multiplayer experience!

Thank you for your continued support, we are very much looking foward in further developing the game together.

notes.title: Version 0.1.3 - Stronger Wylde, Diverse Late Game, Border Scrolling
notes.content:
Fellow Slayers!

We keep reading your feedback and watching you play on YouTube and Twitch. This is what we changed this week:

Stronger Wylde
Wylde is a lot stronger now, especially in the early game. We raised both his base damage and his damage bonus against Werewolves. Now he cuts through those Werewolf waves like a hot knife through butter! 

Diverse Late Game
We changed our game mechanics to make shrines and auras dramatically more efficient in the late game. This should open up a whole lot of new build options, reward careful placement of shrines and positioning of characters and diversify the roles of the different heroes. We're excited to see how this changes your playstyle!

Border Scrolling
We added border scrolling and arrow key camera movement. Please tell us what you think about it. Is the movement speed ok, or do you want it faster or slower?

Map Balancing
We also continued working on the singleplayer campaign. We increased the number of spells available on Hard and Insane difficulty. And we keep making sure that maps don't constantly switch between paths to allow more strategic gameplay.

Skip Victory Screen
And last, but not least, by popular request, you can now finally skip the victory screen animations!

We also fixed a couple of smaller bugs and inconsistencies. You can read the full patch notes here: http://hero-defense.com/PatchNotes.html

If you are interested in a detailed explanation of the aura / shrine mechanics changes, check out our Beta Forum.

Keep sending us your feedback, so we can make the game better!

    Your Hero Defense Team

We also continued working on the singleplayer campaign. We increased the number of spells available on Hard and Insane difficulty. And we keep making sure that maps don't constantly switch between paths to allow more strategic gameplay.

Skip Victory Screen
And last, but not least, by popular request, you can now finally skip the victory screen animations!

We also fixed a couple of smaller bugs and inconsistencies. You can read the full patch notes here: http://hero-defense.com/PatchNotes.html

If you are interested in a detailed explanation of the aura / shrine mechanics changes, check out our Beta Forum.

Keep sending us your feedback, so we can make the game better!

    Your Hero Defense Team
